description: An LED-block equalizer for Power BI — every category becomes a column of stacked blocks, with its peak held above the stack. It reads like studio metering hardware rather than a bar chart, which is exactly the point on a wallboard. Codex Equalizer Bar is for comparing a handful of categories where the shape of the board matters as much as the numbers — channel revenue, regional load, utilisation by line. IDEAL FOR Channel, region or product comparisons on a dark dashboard Wallboards and operations screens that need presence at a distance Any measure with a per-category peak, benchmark or target to hold above the bar Reports that want a distinctive look without a custom build KEY FEATURES Two colour modes — by value, where each column takes its own band colour, or spectrum, where colour runs across the whole board Block resolution is yours: set the number of rows for a fine meter or a chunky board Adjustable block width Optional peak markers, driven by a separate Peak / Target field Band colours for green, amber and red are all configurable Sort order field controls the order columns appear in Optional axis titles with their own colour Full font control on category labels — family, size, bold, italic, colour and alignment Background colour with transparency, border with width, colour and radius Card signature accent with style, colour, corner radius and…
